title: CoSyn: Detecting Implicit Hate Speech in Online Conversations Using a Context Synergized Hyperbolic Network
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of a model (CoSyn) to detect implicit hate speech. While hate speech can target religious groups, the paper's primary focus is on classification performance and hyperbolic geometry in neural networks rather than evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, or ethical frameworks themselves. The included 'Ethics Statement' and 'Limitations' sections do not qualify as benchmarking ethics per the instructions.
